feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: Following big Democratic wins, these swing voters are looking for results
entry.summary: For the swing voters NPR is regularly checking in with as part of its Swing Shift series, the election results brought mixed emotions, as does the pending Democratic control of Congress.

entry.title: U.S. officials look to Europe to learn how to make prison better
entry.summary: American prison officials are looking to European nations like Germany and Norway for a roadmap on how to design a prison that emphasizes rehabilitation and a successful return to life on the outside.

entry.title: Oil giant ExxonMobil left Venezuela years ago. Now it's considering a return
entry.summary: ExxonMobil has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Venezuelan government and its state-owned oil company to explore opportunities in the country.

entry.title: Volunteer musicians play songs for veterans who are hospitalized
entry.summary: Volunteer musicians play for veterans and others who are hospitalized. They're part of Musicians On Call, a group that spreads the healing power of music.

entry.title: Swatters are using AI voices to deceive 911 dispatchers, and it's only getting worse
entry.summary: Swatters are increasingly using AI technology that creates synthetic voices or sound effects to generate remarkably believable fake emergency calls to law enforcement.

entry.title: Federal government failed to hold Epstein accountable, Republican committee says
entry.summary: The Republican chair of the House Oversight Committee released a scathing report after a 15-month investigation into Jeffrey Epstein and his associates. It faulted the federal government with decades of failing to hold Epstein accountable.

entry.title: The average cost for a new vehicle in the U.S. hits a record high: over $51,000
entry.summary: Vehicle transaction prices are up to a new record high, according to the Kelley Blue Book — and some buyers are extending their car loans to finance them.

entry.title: The Democratic Party gained power across the country in the midterms. Now what?
entry.summary: Voters handed Democrats the keys to power across the country and expect them to drive in a different direction. Party leaders are now trying to figure out which way to go.

entry.title: California voters defeat billionaire tax proposal that divided Democrats
entry.summary: The novel proposal would have charged billionaires a one-time 5% tax on most of their overall wealth, including their ownership in companies.

entry.title: Supreme Court says border wall construction can continue in west Texas
entry.summary: The Trump administration filed an emergency relief request with the high court earlier in October asking for the construction to continue while a lawsuit over the plan moves forward.
